channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump targets Iran’s trade lifelines — here are the countries most exposed
item.description: Washington's threat of "economic D-Day" collides with a small group of governments that account for most of what remains of Iran's foreign trade.

item.title: SEC reportedly subpoenas Wall Street banks over AI hedge fund Situational Awareness's near collapse
item.description: The SEC is seeking information from major Wall Street banks about trades and financing tied to AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness.

item.title: BlackBerry CEO says robotics is one of its fastest-growing businesses
item.description: BlackBerry CEO John Giamatteo says robotics is one of QNX’s fastest-growing businesses as the company expands its software beyond cars.

item.title: Lego posts record first-half revenue, CEO touts strong sales at high-end and value pricing
item.description: Lego CEO Niels Christiansen told CNBC the company is seeing strong sales at both ends of the pricing spectrum.

item.title: These 'overlooked gems' pay attractive income, a dividend specialist says
item.description: Seek out these dividend-paying names, says ClearBridge Investments' Michael Clarfeld.

item.title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
item.description: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

item.title: Treasury yields steady as traders await more economic data
item.description: Treasury yields steadied on Tuesday as investors await more data releases for insights into the U.S. economic picture.

item.title: Trump’s oil and gas stocks gained up to $15.5 million amid Iran war, congressional Democrats say
item.description: Trump’s stock trading could face heightened congressional scrutiny if Democrats retake either chamber in the midterms.

item.title: Bitcoin price extends gains as crypto rally gathers pace
item.description: Bitcoin initially surged past the $80,000 mark, as renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite extended the recent crypto rally.

item.title: Jim Cramer says the data center trade is under attack. Here’s who could benefit
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Monday the data center trade isn't dead, but its next wave of winners could look very different.

item.title: Dragon Ball Z theme park gets $7 billion green light
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman agree on a $7 bn investment in the anime theme park.

item.title: Los Angeles Lakers worth 'every bit' of $12.5 billion price tag: 76ers and Commanders owner Josh Harris
item.description: The Los Angeles Lakers set a new record for a professional team sale price at $12.5 billion, and sports investor Josh Harris said the team is worth "every bit."

item.title: Supreme Court allows some Trump vote-by-mail limits ahead of midterm election
item.description: The unsigned order lifted an injunction covering 23 states and Washington, D.C.; the court’s three liberal justices dissented.

item.title: New Delhi draws in $73 billion in 11 weeks, powered by special deposits for non-resident Indians
item.description: India has attracted inflows of $73 billion in 11 weeks, driven mostly by foreign currency bank deposits made by non-resident Indians.

item.title: Main Street Sports sues Comcast, Charter for underpaid licensing fees
item.description: Main Street has been in the process of winding down its portfolio of regional sports networks since the the NHL and NBA seasons ended earlier this year.

item.title: Gold price hovers at three-month high on dollar weakness, Treasury bond buyback plans
item.description: Gold prices fell Tuesday after rising to their highest in over three months.

item.title: Porsche inks $1.5 billion deal for AI deployment with India’s largest IT services firm Tata Consultancy
item.description: Indian IT services giant TCS has secured a $1.5 billion contract to deploy AI for German sports carmaker Porsche.

item.title: Why bitcoin has more room to run after biggest 3-day gain since 2023, according to analysts
item.description: Bitcoin's outsized rebound last week could prove more than just a short-lived relief rally.

item.title: Mark Walter's TWG Global hires Goldman veteran Markowitz as top lawyer amid probe of insurers
item.description: Federal authorities are investigating how two insurers that are part of Mark Walter's business empire classified more than $20 billion in loans to his companies.

item.title: Jim Cramer says don't sell Meta on litigation risk — the stock is worth the wait
item.description: Meta's court battles are an overhang on the stock, but its business fundamentals make it one worth holding.

item.title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
item.description: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.

item.title: This CD pays 6.0% APY. Here's what you need to know
item.description: Financial Partners Credit Union's eight-month CD is offering the highest return on the market. Learn if you qualify and find out about other top CD terms.

item.title: Nvidia says Groq racks will be online this year following $20 billion purchase
item.description: Nvidia's race to manufacture Groq chips and make them available to customers highlight the growing importance in AI of low-latency inference.

item.title: Goldman Sachs partner warns of 'huge danger' in letting AI replace bankers' reasoning skills
item.description: Goldman Sachs is embracing AI, but one of its senior tech leaders warns that it comes with an unintended risk: weakening the reasoning skills of future bankers.

item.title: Trump says U.S. will hike Canada auto tariffs to 50% as trade war escalates
item.description: President Donald Trump said the U.S. will raise tariffs on imports of cars, trucks and auto parts from Canada to 50% on Jan. 1, 2027.

item.title: U.S. Trade Rep Greer blames Canada for failed tariff talks: 'They wanted more'
item.description: Canadian negotiators left Washington on Friday without a deal to prevent President Trump from enacting new 50% tariffs on about $20 billion worth of goods.

item.title: U.S. to unveil 'greatest financial offensive' against Iran as Tehran threatens ship seizures
item.description: The escalation came as both sides have missed a 60-day ceasefire window to reach a deal, closing off the formal truce mechanism to end the six-month war.

item.title: California AG Rob Bonta cancels Paramount settlement meeting, citing 'lack of good faith'
item.description: California AG Rob Bonta was scheduled to meet with Paramount representatives on Monday, he said, but canceled the meeting.

item.title: A massive trade just happened in gold. The options market is buzzing
item.description: Twenty minutes after the market opened Monday, someone sold almost 116,000 420-strike calls in the SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD) expiring Sept. 18.

item.title: Shein targets $27 billion Hong Kong IPO — a fraction of its 2022 valuation
item.description: Shein is planning to raise up to $13.86 billion in Hong Kong dollars ($1.77 billion) in its initial public offering, according to a filing on Monday.
